metadata.title: Email Bulk Messaging Gateway Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines architectural requirements for regulated bulk messaging subject to CASL, GDPR, and CAN-SPAM. This pattern uses email as a transport mechanism but does not implement secure institutional email or mailbox-based collaboration.

components.title: Regulated Broadcast Messaging
components.description: Outbound broadcast messaging to individual recipients under strict legal and consent obligations.

links.text: Uses email transport concepts without inheriting mailbox or collaboration semantics.
Uses Email (TC048) as a transport technology.
Maps to Marketing Tools and Services (AC031) in the Application Reference Model.

components.remarks: This pattern explicitly excludes mailbox-based communication, collaboration relays, notification gateways, and secure institutional email semantics.
